id: title:Piccirello:always mount the player in its own frame document

review.posthog_relevance: Replay recording playback and shared link behavior, including shared recording autoplay defaults, removal of a feature flag, removal of LLM highlight styling, and shared recording timestamp parameter handling.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded change to the Replay recording playback and shared link behavior. P1.F10.H5 removes a feature flag and its associated conditional rendering, while P1.F12.H1 and P1.F12.H2 add dependency checks and switch statements for shared recording playback. P1.F15.H1 and P1.F20.H3 add test cases and parameter checks for shared recording timestamp.
review.uncertainty: The exact user-facing impact and benefit are not demonstrated; the chunk does not establish tier, adoption or benefit. P1.F10.H5 removes a feature flag, but the removal is not shown to complete or safe. observations.limitations: This chunk does not establish tier, adoption or benefit. P1.F1.H1 changes a shared recording autoplay default, but the rationale and user benefit are not demonstrated. P1.F2.H1 removes a feature flag, but the removal is not shown to complete or safe. P1.F3–P1.F6 are story-only, not production. observations.behavior: Changes the PlayerFrame component and its tests, removing the FEATURE_FLAGS.REPLAY_PLAYER_OWN_DOCUMENT flag and its associated conditional rendering and dependency management.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the flag-dependent path where the player frame could render its own document, and the fallback to an app-document container. This could change the player's behavior and error handling, but the exact user-facing impact depends on whether the flag is still used or if the removal is part of a larger refactoring. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case for t=0, which was previously missing and could have caused a recording to start at an arbitrary position instead of the beginning.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a regression where a user clicking a shared link with ?t=0 would not start at the beginning of the recording.

observations.behavior: Replaces truthiness checks with explicit null/empty checks for timestamp and t parameters, and adds an isPresent helper.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a regression where a user clicking a shared link with ?t=0 would not start at the beginning of the recording.
